user.title: MG5
user.description: Sign in with a secondary MG iSmart account. Home Assistant logs the phone app out of any account it uses. Only a 2022 MG5 Electric is set up. Heated seats, windows, a sunroof and battery heating are not offered, because this car does not run those commands.

data_description.country_code: Required for a phone account. Digits only, for example 358.
data_description.battery_pack: Used to convert state of charge into kWh. The car's own percentage and range are unchanged.

vehicle.title: Choose the MG5
vehicle.description: Cars on this account that are not an MG5 are hidden.

reauth_confirm.title: MG5 password
reauth_confirm.description: iSmart rejected the password. Enter it again.

error.invalid_auth: Could not sign in. Check the account and password.
error.cannot_connect: MG iSmart did not respond. Try again in a minute.
error.timeout: MG iSmart took too long to answer. The car may be asleep. Try again.
error.country_code: Enter the phone country code without a plus, for example 358.
error.unknown: Something went wrong talking to MG iSmart.
error.invalid_email: Enter the email address of the iSmart account.
error.invalid_phone: Enter the phone number of the iSmart account, digits only.

abort.no_mg5: This account has no MG5 Electric. Other MG models are not set up here, because commands that work on them do nothing on a 2022 MG5.

init.title: MG5 options
init.description: State of charge and range come from the car. The battery pack only converts that percentage into kilowatt-hours. Manual updates stop all background polling: the car is read only when you press Refresh or send a command.

data.manual_only: Update only when I press Refresh (no background polling)
